video_title: N3on Gets Real About Fame, Faking His Death & His Fear of Falling Off | Curious Mike

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on the regret of faking his death at 14
quotes.excerpt: There's only one thing, I faked my death. I was 14, I was like, guys, I'm dying.
quotes.quote: There's only one thing, I faked my death. I was 14, I was like, guys, I'm dying. I'd say that's when I definitely regret. A few things happen, but I don't really regret them because it taught me a lot. Going to jail in Dubai, that made me realize that my actions have consequences. That is real life.

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on his fear of his streaming career ending
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to be popping forever. And when that stops, I'm so scared of how I'm going to feel.
quotes.quote: I don't care for the money. The money doesn't keep me going. I'm not going to be popping forever. And when that stops, I'm so scared of how I'm going to feel.

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on his work ethic compared to other streamers
quotes.excerpt: I don't think I'm the most entertaining streamer or the best, but I think I'm the hardest working.
quotes.quote: I don't think I'm the most entertaining streamer or the best, but I think I'm the hardest working. Out of every streamer, I work the hardest. I'm the most consistent. I'm always doing different shit, bringing new people on, traveling to different places. I really feel like I have that, and that's why I found success. That's the only thing that separates me from others.

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on the importance of consistency in his career
quotes.excerpt: My mindset is I just won't stop until I get what I want, no matter what it takes.
quotes.quote: My mindset is I just won't stop until I get what I want, no matter what it takes. Obsession. I'm obsessed with it. I'm obsessed with streaming. You can't get what you want, but the problem I have now is the balance. I just need to find a balance between reality because I don't see streaming as real life.

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on his experience with toxic relationships and falling off
quotes.excerpt: I built all this up for years and years, I got all of it, I got the girls, the cars.
quotes.quote: I built all this up for years and years, I got all of it, I got the girls, the cars, the money and everything and I just took it all for granted and lost everything. People stopped giving a fuck about me, everyone hated me. It was a terrible time, so I don't want to ever live that again.

quotes.speaker: N3on

quotes.excerpt: Don't have the wrong girl around you, that will kill everything.
quotes.quote: Don't have the wrong girl around you, that will kill everything. Toxic shit, the arguing, having a stream all day and then you come back to an argument. Why are you doing this? Why are you out so late? I'm working for us, you know? But the wrong girl can really kill everything.

quotes.speaker: N3on

Not all of them, but there's just certain ones and they're very smart and they play the game and they did this with another guy before and it's just like, they a lot of them know what they're doing. quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on his early days of content creation
quotes.excerpt: I had 20 YouTube accounts, 20. And after every upload, every day, I would make a new account.
quotes.quote: I had 20 YouTube accounts, 20. And after every upload, every day, I would make a new account and comment on my own videos and try to push my own self. I learned Photoshop, I was like I need a network, I need to meet these people, I need to DM them and offer them free thumbnails. I was doing whatever it took, nothing worked.

quotes.speaker: N3on
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on on his health struggles and motivation
quotes.excerpt: I was really sick, I wasn't going to school. I have Crohn's disease, it's a lot of inflammation.
quotes.quote: I was really sick, I wasn't going to school. I have Crohn's disease, it's a lot of inflammation in my stomach. People with my disease are supposed to be tired and get fatigued quick. The medicine I take is a weekly medicine that kills my immune system, kills it. So all these flights, everything, I should be dead, not dead, but I should be so tired every second.

I got a Facebook deal, Facebook gaming deal, it was like $10,000 a month. I was 16 and that's when my dad started getting on board. And he was like, wow, okay, you can make some money out of this, let's see what you can do.
